newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 29.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section:
VIENNA - OPEC oil ministers agreed to a new six-month freeze of their oil output quotas, an action they hope will keep petroleum prices high despite Iraq's resumption of exports.
BUDAPEST - The opening of two shopping malls in Budapest heralds a new retailing era in Eastern Europe.
GENEVA - The world's major record companies called for a new treaty to protect copyrights on the Internet.
PARIS - Striking truck drivers erected more highway barricades and increased their stranglehold on the French economy as talks broke down.
PORTLAND, Maine - Real Christmas trees apparently have overcome an image problem and are again in demand by nostalgic baby boomers.
